selection: minimum validation MAE, deterministic candidate order
normalization: published all_motor_vehicles per actual direction/hour; no missing-day interpolation
scope: new alternative-source historical demand estimation; no simulator-state or field validation
limitations: The source schema and survey dates were inspected during discovery; this is a new data-source study, not a blinded external replication.
Ten sparse survey dates over 2000-2024 are not current or concurrent traffic.
Unknown historical road geometry and signal timing prevent a physical twin claim.
Fewer than three independent validation or final dates prevent robust date-cluster uncertainty.
